main.summary: Coordinates segmented transfer session operations on top of staged DataServices storage.

method.name: OpenUploadTransfer
method.summary: Open a new staged segmented upload session.
method.returns: Open response containing the initial session state.

method.name: GetTransferIntegrityEvidence
method.summary: Load canonical integrity evidence covering an exact requested prefix of a segmented transfer.
method.returns: Authoritative prefix integrity and its source segment evidence.

method.name: OpenGetTransfer
method.summary: Open a new readable segmented session over published content.
method.returns: Open response containing the initial readable session state.

method.name: ReOpenUploadTransfer
method.summary: Reattach to an existing staged segmented upload session.
method.returns: Reopen response containing the current session state.

method.name: ReOpenGetTransfer
method.summary: Reattach to an existing readable segmented session.
method.returns: Reopen response containing the current readable session state.

method.name: GetTransferState
method.summary: Get the current transfer state for a staged segmented session.

method.name: PutTransferSegment
method.summary: Validate and upload a segmented payload range for an existing staged session.
method.param: Readable segment payload stream positioned at the first byte to upload.

method.name: GetTransferSegment
method.summary: Read a realized segmented payload range from an existing staged session.
method.returns: Segment footer metadata plus a readable payload stream.

method.name: GetSessions
method.summary: Enumerate retained segmented transfer sessions that match the optional filters.

method.name: AbortTransfer
method.summary: Abort an open or complete segmented upload session and delete its staged artifacts. Other modes and states conflict.

method.name: BeginPublishSegmentedTransfer
method.summary: Validate a fully realized staged segmented upload and transition it into the frozen publishing state before external publication begins.
method.param: Mutation scope owning the item and session locks.
method.returns: Response containing the frozen publishing session state prepared for publication.

method.name: ValidateBeginPublishSegmentedTransfer
method.summary: Validate a segmented publication request against the current session without changing its state. Call while holding the mutation scope before creating a publication journal.
method.param: Mutation scope owning the item and session locks.
method.returns: A task representing the validation operation.

method.name: RemoveTransfer
method.summary: Remove retained transfer session artifacts when the session is Complete or Published, unless dependent staged-read or stream-follow sessions still reference it. Other states conflict.

method.name: FinishPublishSegmentedTransfer
method.summary: Finalize a previously begun segmented publish after external publish has succeeded.
method.param: Transfer identity for the publishing upload session.
Mutation scope owning the item and session locks.
method.returns: Final published response for the retained upload session.

method.name: SessionExists
method.summary: Determine whether a retained segmented transfer session exists for the supplied identity.
method.returns: True when the segmented session exists and matches the supplied item.
